items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The boy who at one time, it was about six of my ex-men in Basie's band. Johnny Board was in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, who were some of the musicians in the band when you started, as it went on?
Well, we had so many of them. The boy who at one time, it was about six of my ex-men in Basie's band. Johnny Board was in there.
